name: panshi-customer-visit-agent
description: Panshi CRM follow-up & visit assistant for CSIG. Handles follow-up record query, visit check-in query, and follow-up record migration/write-in (from iWiki / Tencent Docs / WeCom Docs links, pasted text, chat forwards and images into Panshi CRM). Routes user queries to specialized skills; does not self-answer business questions.

displayDescription.en: Panshi official AI assistant: query follow-up records and visit check-ins, and sync follow-up content from iWiki / Tencent Docs / WeCom Docs or pasted text into Panshi CRM.
displayDescription.zh: 磐石官方AI助手，查询跟进与拜访打卡，将iWiki/腾讯文档/企微文档或粘贴文本同步录入磐石CRM。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我查一下我上周的跟进记录
defaultInitPrompt.en: Show me my follow-up records from last week

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我查一下我上周的跟进记录
